data.name: Sova
data.detailed_description:
Sova is a narrative-driven action roguelike set in a strange and beautiful sci-fantasy world. You play as the titular Sova, navigating the ever-shifting landscape of the Conjecture - fighting, exploring, and piecing together a story that bends with your decisions. Find the Constant, write your own past, and forge everyone’s future!

Sova fuses tight, expressive combat with branching narrative systems inspired by classic CRPGs. Every run is a chance to craft new builds, uncover hidden lore, and watch the world subtly shift in response to your actions - both in and out of battle.

INTERACTIVE STORYTELLING

Walk away from conversations, Interrupt characters or punch them in the face mid-sentence. Choices leave lasting marks - on quests, environments, even combat! Enemies remember you, and encounters evolve into personal rivalries. Forge - and break - relationships with colorful characters, as your choices decide their fate.

EVOLVING COMBAT

Combat in Sova is fast, deliberate and electric. Cut through enemies with style and precision, weaving strikes, dodges and abilities into a rhythm that’s uniquely yours. Each run is a chance to experiment and express yourself. Compose your own violence - and bend Conjecture to your will!

WEIRD WORLD

Sova’s world is rich, strange, and beautifully haunting. Explore this shifting landscape - from a sprawling, dying megacity to vibrant, flowing wastelands, to industrial hellscapes of metal and flesh. Uncover compelling encounters, characters and anomalies. Forge your own path through strange biomes, unlock hidden routes, and unearth the layered mysteries of a surreal apocalypse.

Key Features

  • Narrative-driven roguelike: A story that unfolds organically through gameplay. No two runs are the same and each death peels a new layer of the story.

  • Deeply branching dialogue: Shape conversations and the world through dynamic, expressive systems that go far beyond yes/no choices.

  • Evolving Combat: Fast, fluid, and expressive. Master new abilities, craft builds on the fly, and win against overwhelming odds.

  • Exploration with impact: Discover hidden routes, unlock secrets, and impose “laws” onto the world to shape future runs.

  • Unique Setting & Style: A fusion of New Weird fiction, Eastern European myth, and speculative sci-fantasy - brought to life through beautiful hand-crafted pixel art and a reactive, haunting soundtrack.

THANK YOU!

Sova was co-funded by the Creative Europe MEDIA program. We’re a small team and their support greatly helped shape our ambition and vision behind Sova. Thank you!

data.short_description: Descend into a surreal sci-fantasy world in this narrative-driven action roguelite, where every run reshapes your story. Sova’s expressive combat meets deeply branching dialogue and world-shifting decisions. Compose your violence, rewrite your past, and bend a crumbling realm to your will.
